calls.video_title: BUYING The Dip in 4 Stocks Before 2027
calls.price_at_call: No stated price; analyst avg target ~$918 (stated)
calls.thesis: BUY, first tracked - down over 40% from July highs on AI-buildout fears; power generation for data centres is the underappreciated driver; edge score 82, forward P/E 18.8, PEG ~1, EPS $32.18 next year (+18%), target ~$918 implies over 50% upside.
calls.base_case: Data centres are not going away; buildout continues.
calls.bull_case: Power/infrastructure spend underestimated; resilient digital infrastructure needs backup generation.
